title: Vertex AI: Session Compaction and Transcription Refactor
summary: Vertex AI introduces session compaction for long-running agent histories and standardizes speech transcription configurations, alongside a breaking change to traffic type enums.
details_markdown:
A new `compact` method has been added to Reasoning Engine sessions (`projects.locations.reasoningEngines.sessions.compact`). This allows developers to manage context window limits by applying a 'stackable pipeline' of rules to session history, including LLM-based summarization, tool-response truncation, and 'thought stripping.' In transcription news, `languageHints` and `languageAuto` are being deprecated or removed across `GenaiVertexV1beta1TranscriptionConfig` and `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1AudioTranscriptionConfig` in favor of a unified `languageCodes` array. Additionally, `GenaiVertexV1beta1EnvironmentConfig` has moved from camelCase to snake_case for `network_allowlist` and `network_mode` fields.

**Breaking Change:** The `trafficType` enum used in `UsageMetadata` has changed its 5th value (index 4) from `PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT` to `ON_DEMAND_OFFPEAK`. Developers relying on this specific enum value for billing or monitoring logic should update their code immediately.

title: New jobType for Materialized View Refresh assignments
summary: BigQuery now supports assigning reservations specifically for automated materialized view refreshes, allowing for better resource isolation and prioritization.
details_markdown: BigQuery Reservation API introduces `MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH` under the `jobType` enum for Capacity Commitments and Reservations. This allows organizations to separate batch ETL queries from continuous materialized view background maintenance.

title: Continuous Query & Iceberg Table Ingestion Extensions
summary: BigQuery adds native continuous SQL streaming table configurations and extends external Iceberg catalog options.
details_markdown: BigQuery adds support for continuous streaming query targets, as well as extended BigLake Iceberg REST catalog authentication fields.

title: Dataplex adds ChangeRequest comments and EntryLinkType events
summary: Dataplex now supports reviewer comments on ChangeRequests and introduces a new event schema for tracking EntryLinkType lifecycle changes.
details_markdown: Dataplex adds support for reviewer comments in `ChangeRequest` workflows, alongside metadata event types for tracking data lineage links across projects.

title: Improved Git branch handling and path clarifications
summary: Dataform clarifies default branch behavior and enhances repository path validation.
details_markdown: Dataform API v1 introduces explicit validation for Git default branch names and repository root directory path strings.
